d: In this video, Firstpost tells the unusual travel story of Helen and Mick, a British couple who fell in love with an Indian auto-rickshaw during their 75-day journey across India. Covering 4,218 kilometres, the couple travelled with their trusty three-wheeler, Timmy the Tin Can, visiting destinations including the Taj Mahal. But they weren't ready to leave their beloved ride behind. They shipped Timmy all the way to the UK, waiting six months for its arrival at London Gateway Port. Now, the little auto has a new home, but one final hurdle remains before it can hit British roads!…
